'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**[[2024 New Way Cargo Airlines Ilyushin Il-76 shootdown]]
***An [[Ilyushin Il-76]] [[cargo aircraft|cargo plane]] crashes in [[North Darfur]], [[Sudan]], killing its crew of two [[Russians]] and three Sudanese nationals. The [[Rapid Support Forces]] claim that they shot down the aircraft with a [[surface-to-air missile]] and say that they have recovered the airplane's [[flight recorder]]. [[Russia]] says that its diplomats in Sudan are currently investigating the crash. [https://sudantribune.com/article292339/ (''Sudan Tribune'')] [https://apnews.com/article/sudan-cargo-jet-shot-down-russia-rsf-war-2ddf073f44918eacd3d09357f0d39529 (AP)]
**A [[Sudanese Armed Forces]] jet bombs a [[mosque]] in [[Wad Madani]], [[Gezira State]], killing at least 31 people. The attack coincides with the RSF launching an assault across the state following the defection of the [[Rapid Support Forces]]' top commander in the state to the SAF. [https://sudantribune.com/article292352/ (''Sudan Tribune'')]
*[[Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)|Israel–Hezbollah conflict]]
**Thirteen people are killed and 57 more wounded during [[Israel]]i [[airstrike]]s near [[Rafik Hariri University Hospital]] in [[Beirut]], [[Lebanon]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2024/10/22/live-scenes-of-terror-in-northern-gaza-as-israel-bombs-beirut (Al Jazeera)]
**Israel launches airstrikes across [[Lebanon]], including in Beirut and the [[Beqaa Valley]], targeting financial institutions that are allegedly linked to [[Hezbollah]]. [https://apnews.com/article/israel-palestinians-hamas-lebanon-10-20-2024-42ea48ce0f6a31d53a25dc50f16796bc (AP)]

**Seven people are killed and five others are injured in a [[mass shooting]] at a camp for [[construction worker]]s near [[Sonamarg]], [[Jammu and Kashmir (union territory)|Jammu and Kashmir]], [[India]]. '''Law and crime'''
*[[2000 Sipadan kidnappings]]
**A [[Regional Trial Court|trial court]] in [[Taguig]], [[Philippines]], [[convict]]s 17 leaders and members of [[Abu Sayyaf]], including two top officials of the [[Rajah Sulaiman Movement]] who were on the [[United Nations Security Council]]'s Sanctions List, of the [[kidnapping]] of 21 [[tourism in Malaysia|tourists]] from [[Sipadan]], [[Malaysia]], in 2000. The [[convict]]s are [[sentence (law)|sentenced]] to ''[[Reclusión perpetua#Philippines|reclusión perpetua]]''. [https://www.scmp.com/news/asia/southeast-asia/article/3283186/philippines-gives-abu-sayyaf-kidnappers-life-prison-malaysia-resort-abductions (AFP via ''SCMP'')] [https://www.pna.gov.ph/articles/1235964 (PNA)]
*[[Operation Car Wash]]
**A court in [[Peru]] sentences former [[Peruvian president|president]] [[Alejandro Toledo]] to 20 years and six months in prison for receiving bribes. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/peru-ex-president-toledo-sentenced-two-decades-prison-accepting-bribes-2024-10-21/ (Reuters)]
*Five members of a family, including three teenagers, are killed in a [[mass shooting]] in [[Fall City]], [[Washington (state)|Washington]], [[United States]]. [https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/nation/2024/10/21/fall-city-washington-murders/75780678007/ (''USA Today'')]
*Former [[president of Albania|Albanian president]] [[Ilir Meta]] is arrested on accusations of [[corruption]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/albanias-ex-president-meta-detained-by-police-spokesman-says-2024-10-21/ (Reuters)]
